name: ScanFace concept v1
status: Visual proposal, not an implemented application

typography.familyIntent: Single native or Inter-like sans serif

adaptiveLayout.compact: Single pane with bottom navigation. Capture is a focused flow with a close control.
adaptiveLayout.medium: Navigation rail; single content pane or list-detail according to usable width.
adaptiveLayout.expanded: Navigation rail plus scan history list and selected-result detail.
adaptiveLayout.captureExpanded: Camera preview beside capture guidance; avoid stretching the preview.
adaptiveLayout.scrolling: Content remains scrollable with dynamic text and window resizing.

contentPrinciples: Label the primary output Estimated facial age.
Show entered chronological age only when supplied voluntarily.
Treat age difference neutrally, without good/bad colors.
Capture quality describes the photo, not the reliability of a health claim.
Do not invent health scores or confidence percentages.
Historical estimates must not imply verified improvement or deterioration in health.
Display model provenance in expandable estimate details in production.
Any image retention or export is an explicit user choice.
All portraits, measurements and dates in these concepts are fictional examples.
implementationRequirements: Apply semantic themes to navigation, charts, dialogs, sheets, settings, loading, disabled, error and empty states.
Respond to OS theme changes while System is selected.
Adapt platform status and navigation bars to the chosen app theme.
Never recolor the camera preview or stored portraits when switching themes.
Use textual or icon cues alongside status colors.
Use strong outlines for controls that require a visible boundary; subtle outlines are decorative.
Honor reduced-motion settings and dynamic text.
Validate theme contrast and accessibility in the implemented app; raster concepts are not pixel specifications.
